name: In My Heart of Hearts
source:
The war between Rutwald and Kaimos will soon come to an end. Your only hope of saving your kingdom is by allying with the Western kingdom of Saris. All of the details are already sorted, except which of the three princes you, the only princess of Rutwald, will marry to seal the alliance. You have five days to make your decision.

[From [url=https://edgessystem.itch.io/in-my-heart-of-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鲁特瓦尔德和凯莫斯之间的战争很快就会结束。你拯救王国的唯一希望就是与西方萨里斯王国结盟。所有细节都已整理完毕，除了你（鲁特瓦尔德唯一的公主）将与三位王子中的哪一位结婚以缔结联盟。你有五天时间做出决定。

[来自[url=https://edgessystem.itch.io/in-my-heart-of-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
